definition: long strips of potato cooked in hot fat
description: At night at a busy street food stall full of steam and hanging light bulbs, a smiling young man in a grey bandana, white T-shirt and white apron pours golden potato fries from a wire frying basket into a white paper cone. He then turns and hands the full cone to a laughing man in the small crowd, who reaches out for it while the others cheer. Steel deep fryers stand on the counter, with more fries in a tray and spilled from a metal cup.

taps.target: the man in the grey T-shirt

de.answer: Er serviert einem Kunden die Pommes.
